description: payload = "RLX1" | version 0x01 | entries (type u8 | len u8 | value), at most 64 bytes; LINK_CAPS (type 0x01, len 4) is u32 BE in the RIH1 caps namespace, bit 8 = RRH1, bit 9 = PAD1. A listener built before PAD1 reads the same caps and ignores bit 9 (only bits it knows count), so it never pads
name: RLX1 LINK_CAPS with PAD1 (RAVEN_ROUTE_HINTS_V1 §3.2, RAVEN_LINK_PADDING_V1 §3)
